subject.title: Concurrent message handling per session (async agent turns)

question: Should OpenClaw support true same-session parallel/fast-lane turns, or should it preserve one active session writer and improve steering, interruption, and foreground fairness instead?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally serialize sessions to protect transcripts, tool side effects, and active-run ownership; changing that is a product and safety contract, not a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Preserve One Writer And Improve Fairness
options.body: Keep one active writer per session and design foreground user/control priority, steering, interruption, and followup fairness within that safety boundary.

options.title: Adopt A Fast-Lane Mode
options.body: Review or replace the linked fork PR with explicit tool limits, transcript ownership, queue-drain isolation, and real Discord/channel proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into The Broader Concurrency Umbrella
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53023 the only product tracker if maintainers want one configurable session-concurrency and auto-yield design thread.

recommendation.title: Preserve One Writer And Improve Fairness
recommendation.body: Keep one active writer per session and design foreground user/control priority, steering, interruption, and followup fairness within that safety boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across command queue, queue policy, reply runner, and queue docs.
